title: Cook's visit to the Bell site in the Waldenburg mine
summary: Nick Cook tells of Cook's visit to the Bell site in the Waldenburg mine, about World War II; visited 1990s-2000s at Waldenburg, southern Poland, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Nick Cook visits the underground Bell rig

plain: Nick Cook, a British journalist who wrote a book called The Hunt for Zero Point, says he went with a Polish researcher named Igor Witkowski to the place where the Bell, a secret device supposedly built by Nazi Germany during the Second World War, was said to have been installed: deep in a mine at Waldenburg, in what is now southern Poland. Podcast host Jesse Michels retells the visit, saying the trip involved a boat ride underground and that Cook saw the test rig where the device stood, which would suggest the wartime project was real.
